name: Are there alternatives to a sale-leaseback if I want to sell and stay?

mainEntity.name: Are there alternatives to a sale-leaseback if I want to sell and stay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, other options exist if you want to sell and remain in your home. One alternative is a 'post-occupancy agreement' or 'seller rent-back,' typically for a shorter, defined period after closing, often 30-60 days. Another might involve a delayed closing date, giving you more time before the sale is final. The best option depends on how long you need to stay and the buyer's flexibility. We help clients in areas like Aventura and Coral Gables evaluate these choices to match their specific timelines and needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alternatives to a sale-leaseback include post-occupancy agreements for shorter periods or delayed closing dates, depending on your timeline and buyer flexibility.
